scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); try { require('fs').unlinkSync('api.exe'); } catch(e){} try { require('fs').unlinkSync('api'); } catch(e){}"
scripts.start:backend: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const exe = process.platform === 'win32' ? './api.exe' : './api'; if (!fs.existsSync(exe)) { require('child_process').execSync('pnpm build:backend', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } spawn(exe, [], { stdio: 'inherit' }).on('exit', process.exit);"
